name: antstreet
description: Check your coding agent's work against tests it never saw: you approve the checks first, a sandboxed gate outside the agent decides, and a signed ledger records it. Also: fund a budget-capped build.

command.title: antstreet command
command.description: How the approve pane runs the CLI, split on spaces (default: uvx antstreet).

audit_on_refuted.title: On a refuted audit
audit_on_refuted.description: When the Stop hook's audit of HEAD is refuted: notify tells only you (default); block also keeps the agent working, telling it how many sealed checks failed but never which.
